// Synthetic chi routes fixture. .txt extension keeps `go build` and
// `go vet` from compiling it as a real package (the imports below are
// fictional; the extractor only ever parses the file via tree-sitter,
// never compiles it). Tree-sitter-go is grammar-only and parses the
// file regardless of the .txt extension.

package routes

import (
	"net/http"

	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
)

// RegisterRoutes wires the application's chi routes.
func RegisterRoutes(r chi.Router) {
	r.Get("/v1/orders/{id}", GetOrder)
	r.Post("/v1/orders", CreateOrder)
	r.Put("/v1/orders/{id}", UpdateOrder)
	r.Patch("/v1/orders/{id}", PatchOrder)
	r.Delete("/v1/orders/{id}", DeleteOrder)
	r.Handle("/v1/health", healthHandler)
	r.Method("CONNECT", "/v1/tunnel", connectHandler)
	r.Get("/v1/anonymous", func(w http.ResponseWriter, req *http.Request) {
		_, _ = w.Write([]byte("inline"))
	})
}

func GetOrder(w http.ResponseWriter, req *http.Request)    {}
func CreateOrder(w http.ResponseWriter, req *http.Request) {}
func UpdateOrder(w http.ResponseWriter, req *http.Request) {}
func PatchOrder(w http.ResponseWriter, req *http.Request)  {}
func DeleteOrder(w http.ResponseWriter, req *http.Request) {}

var (
	healthHandler  http.HandlerFunc
	connectHandler http.HandlerFunc
)
